author: FrostedCupcakez
body:
Hey all! Today I've started a new forum game called One Word Story! The title explains it all, so here are the rules:

1. Each player only gets one word per post
2. Keep the story clean, try not to swear or use dirty language
3. Although this is a ONE word story please don't spam the topic continuously ^-^
4. Be respectful of all players

I'll try my best to put down all the words so players can just read the story instead of scrolling :D 
So let us begin! I'll start with the word....

Once on Upon Batman an bad scrub Says eZ
Avicus And bad Cherry Thinks af furry bacca minus Ebola 
Equals cheese dog furry Which bacca Doesn't bajancandiaian eats furies Pie bacca poops Doesn't Scrub pies Higher

Although it makes no sense at all, nice effort everyone +1 xD
